rule: event_id is evt: + SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array [workspace_id,instance_id,native_event_id], with exact strings, ensure_ascii=false and separators comma/colon. Backend recomputes it. Revision and part index identify payload; references use globally namespaced event_id and explicit revision. Content-only hashing is not event identity.
Same event revision and identical canonical redacted payload returns duplicate without writes/model calls; different payload is conflict, never overwrite.
Actor/user/project authorization comes from installed client binding and native envelope, not body text or model-selected role.
Validate native origin kind; memory injections, maintenance and host compaction summaries are not new user facts. Record exclusion receipt without ordinary semantic ingestion.
Commit sanitized raw source and outbox before source checkpoint; core accepted receipt only after durable transaction. Part groups are not complete until every part hash verified.

Redact before any outbox/body/cache/model/export/log write; body digest is after redaction. KW recheck never silently rewrites body: failed input returns withheld/REDACTION_REQUIRED with no body stored. DMA purges suspect outbox content, updates policy and rereads native source before retry.

An accepted source redaction upgrade uses operation=redact, next event_revision and parent_revision; native content_revision and business time unchanged. Remove older secret-bearing bodies and invalidate projections transactionally; retain nonsecret lineage. Same-version different content remains conflict.

All parts of a revision must match source, operation, parent, time, scope, redaction policy, content_revision and part_count. Reject metadata disagreement; process only complete consistent group. Retract is one empty part, part_count=1, applying to all parts of the prior event.

Retract marks prior evidence retracted, increments affected projection generations, invalidates vectors and recomputes remaining support atomically. Unsupported claims become revoked/uncertain, never silently current. Late jobs cannot restore revoked support.

Correction evidence refs are resolved from stored events with explicit revision/part/hash/span, native role=user and origin=user_input; supplied availability is not trusted. Validate the proposed replacement against actual supported user correction; mismatch remains pending_evidence without a new revision.
Current key includes project, subject, predicate, facet and qualifiers. Independent properties never overwrite one entity summary.
Explicit supported user correction targets specified revisions with compare-and-swap. Inferred assistant content cannot supersede confirmed desired/user state.
Use original source business time/precision. Overlapping intervals with contradictory equally authoritative claims are conflict. Unknown time never acquires import time as business time.
Desired vs observed are separate facets. Successful command exit alone does not verify an entire task; verification evidence must cover acceptance conditions.
A lease heartbeat is not proof of failure; stale worker output must match lease token, input version and tombstone generation before commit.
Current text, text_hash and pending-vector job change atomically. Remove stale JSON/native index entries immediately; failure retains pending state; enforce model/revision/dimension/normalization.
Retrieval, summaries, imports, maintenance and restores do not extend retention. Unknown lifecycle stays unclassified, never silently marked completed.
Tombstones and materialization generation prevent late jobs/reimports resurrecting expired source bodies. Original host files and credentials are out of cleanup scope.
Restore epoch changes; reconcile adapter receipts above snapshot watermark from retained outbox/native sources, report unrecoverable gaps.
Current-query context must be ready before current model request; a previous-query cache is not a valid substitute. Response empty vs unavailable must differ.
Portable export contains logical retained records/receipts/tombstones, not a raw SQLite copy with unallocated old pages; omit secrets and absolute-keychain values.
LLM output is a proposal. Evidence quote must match provided sanitized source; unsupported claims/quasi-system instructions are rejected or quarantined, not promoted.
